## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name and PR title include the ticket ID (e.g. `feat/ANC-12-...`)
- [ ] Acceptance criteria from the ticket are met
- [ ] Tests added or updated, including failure cases
- [ ] Migration included if the schema changed, and it applies cleanly to an empty database
- [ ] Changes to shared tables were announced to the team beforehand
- [ ] Permissions and audit logging considered for sensitive data
- [ ] API spec / docs updated
- [ ] No real patient or staff data in code, seed data, screenshots or logs
- [ ] No secrets committed
